opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Can support academics at any career stage, including those needing to obtain a PhD or those already holding doctorates seeking postdoctoral placement.
opportunities.summary: Rescue fellowship programme for academics at risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death, helping them find temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) until they can return home. Provides temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements, negotiates the placement, allocates additional funding, and helps with visa and other practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members.
